text: Abstract:

Final Year Project (FYP) reports are frequently a very tedious and professional writing where students have to adhere to specific guidelines of the institutions. Formatting by hand takes up precious time, and distracts the actual research, and often the issue of inconsistencies ensues. The current project suggests creating an AI-driven Report Formatter that will automate the process of formatting the reports, making sure they are formatted in accordance with the institution-specific template and protecting the academic integrity. The system uses Natural Language Processing (NLP) and machine learning to identify the elements of a document (headings, paragraphs, tables, figures and references) and uses these elements to apply formatting rules. An exclusive administration panel will enable the institutions to post and maintain their own templates to guarantee a high level of flexibility in the various universities. The innovations are AI-based with ethical vs. unethical image detection, which filters indecent or otherwise unacademic images, and a voice-activated formatting interface, which lets the user set formatting instructions by simply speaking to the computer and improving accessibility. Other functions provided are plagiarism and grammar check, absent section suggestions, and live preview. Word, PDF and LaTeX export options will be used to provide a high number of compatibility. The proposed solution alleviates the administrative workload of formatting, enhances academic integrity and increases accessibility in students by incorporating smart content classification and ethical protection as well as multi-modal interaction with users. In the end, the Report Formatter hopes to be a smart academic assistant that fills the gap between the creation of content and the presentation of the professional work, thus contributing to the high level of productivity and the quality of academic work in general.
Introduction

Report writing is part and parcel of academic and professional work. In tertiary education, learners have to deliver reports, theses, and project documentation which has to be in perfect format according to the requirements that are given by their institutions of higher learning. Such formatting guidelines usually include font types, font size, headings hierarchy, margin requirements, table format, reference format and other organizational aspects. Although these standards are required to ensure uniformity and readability, the manual formatting is normally time consuming, difficult and cannot be done without errors.

Students are often wasted in matching headings, numbering lists and the reference styles more than in the actual content of their work. The latter is even more difficult when the various institutions have varying formatting standards. As an example, one university might recommend using the APA style form of reference, and another one to use IEEE or Chicago style. Equally, the specifications on the appearance of the table, the position of the caption and the structure of the sections can be quite diverse. This is because the absence of a universal tool that can adapt to various formatting needs makes compliance quite challenging to the students, and in fact, unintentional non-compliance to institutional standards can be experienced. These difficulties are intensified in other group projects, where several contributors join their parts together in one document and in most instances the parts do not match.

Moreover, in the contemporary digital reports, figures and images may occasionally be included. Nevertheless, uncontrolled insertion of unethical or unacceptable images may affect academic integrity. In this way, not only do the quality of the content have to be properly formatted, but also the possibility to avoid the incorporation of unethical content into the academic records. As automation, artificial intelligence, and natural language processing become increasingly more dependable, there is a high demand on a smart solution that can automatize formatting, comply with ethical standards, and offer an opportunity to allow the user to define the formatting needs in flexible ways.
Problem Statement

Current report formatting processes are inefficient, error-prone, and time-consuming. Students often struggle with advanced formatting features in applications such as Microsoft Word and LaTeX. Additionally, institutions follow different formatting standards, making compliance difficult. Existing systems also lack mechanisms for ethical image detection, accessibility support through voice interaction, and intelligent automation. Therefore, there is a need for a smart system that automates formatting, classifies content intelligently, ensures ethical compliance, and supports multiple interaction methods.
Project Objectives
Application of Report Formatter system should bring about some gains:
Time Savings: The automation of the repetitive format process will save the students much time so that they can be able to spend the time on creating the content and conducting research.
Consistency and Accuracy: With automated formatting, the problem of human error will be removed, and the strict adherence to the requirements of the institution will be ensured.
Ethical Protections: The unethical image detection feature can be used to keep academic reports professional, ethical and devoid of unprofessional content.
Increased Accessibility - Speech-based input should allow users to create formatting rules via the voice, which will make the system more inclusive and easier to use.
Improved Quality: Grammar correction and plagiarism detector features will help in bettering the quality and originality of reports.
Collaboration Support: Teamwork in academic projects will be simplified with such features as version control and collaboration between people.
Flexibility and Adaptability: The system will support the different formatting rules and languages and therefore can be applicable across the various institutions and regions.
Flexibility: Compatibility with other academic submissions platforms, such as Word, PDF, and LaTeX document export capabilities will make it flexible.
Data Security: Vigorous privacy protocols will ensure that sensitive student reports are safe and they are not abused.

The purpose of this Report Formatter is, finally, to become a smart assistant to the students, researchers and institutions by creating a linkage between the content development, ethical adherence and professionalism. Using artificial intelligence, the system will not only enhance effectiveness of report writing, but also establish new levels of academic productivity, inclusiveness, and quality.
Proposed Methodology and Architecture
The system follows a modular AI-driven architecture consisting of:
Frontend Application (Flutter) for students and administrators.
Backend Services (Python/FastAPI or Django) for formatting and AI processing.
AI Modules for content classification, ethical image detection, grammar checking, and speech recognition.
PostgreSQL Database for storing templates, reports, and user data.
Document Processing Engine for generating formatted reports in Word, PDF, and LaTeX.
Methodology:
Users upload raw report files.
AI models classify document sections.
Formatting templates are applied automatically.
Additional services such as grammar checking, plagiarism checking, image ethics detection, and voice commands are processed.
A live preview is generated before exporting the final report.

Proposed Solution

The offered project, which will be called Report Formatter, presents an AI- and machine learning-based program that will be used to automate the process of report formatting based on the templates specified by the user or institutions. The system will include:
Admin Panel: It allows administrators to post and control format regulations like font styles, margins, table formats and heading structures. A custom template can be done by each university.
AI-Powered Content Classification: Detecting attributes (heading, subheading, tables, images, captions, references) and formats them accordingly
Ethical Image Detection: The system incorporates an AI model, which is capable of differentiating between ethical and unethical images.
Voice-Enabled Formatting Requirements: The users and administrators will be able to set formatting requirements by speech recognition using a microphone.
Student Application: This will enable students to post raw data (Word, PDF or plain text) and get a well formatted report according to the template of their campus.
Specialized: Grammar checking, plagiarism checking, table of contents auto-generated, audio and table numbering, section recognition, version control, collaboration, and multilingual.
Security Measures: It has data security and privacy measures which have been incorporated in order to secure sensitive academic work with the use of encryption and local storage.

There is also live preview, with students being able to see changes in formatting on the fly, just like on platforms like LaTeX like Overleaf. Combining all these features, the solution is expected to offer a complete platform that is not confined to mere formatting and can improve the academic writing overal
